import {createElement as h} from 'react'
import {createRoot} from 'react-dom/client'
import {flushSync} from 'react-dom'
import {DetailPage,ScopedPanel} from './src/client.js'
const root=createRoot(document.getElementById('root')),requests=[],checks=[]
const tick=()=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,30)),text=()=>document.getElementById('root').textContent
const check=(name,condition)=>{if(!condition)throw Error(name+'; DOM: '+text());checks.push({name,pass:true})}
const wait=async predicate=>{for(let i=0;i<50&&!predicate();i++)await tick();if(!predicate())throw Error('Fixture wait failed')}
// Deliberately ignore AbortSignal when settling: components must reject stale completions themselves.
window.fetch=(url,options={})=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>requests.push({url:new URL(url,'http://own-fixture'),signal:options.signal,done:false,resolve(value){this.done=true;resolve({ok:true,json:async()=>value})},reject(error){this.done=true;reject(error)}}))
const row={id:'mvu:own',adapterId:'tavern.mvu',name:'Own fixture',managementMode:'managed',sourceDefault:{available:false,reason:'SOURCE_DEFAULTS_UNAVAILABLE',message:'旧范围拒绝'},capabilities:{edit:false},facts:[],activeFacts:[]}
const success={id:row.id,adapterId:row.adapterId,revision:1,local:null,config:{id:row.id,adapterId:row.adapterId,type:'mvu-state',whitelist:[],blacklist:[],store:{},retrieve:{}},origins:{},sourceAvailable:true,sourceDefault:{available:true,revision:'own-source-v1'}}
const denial={...success,config:null,sourceDefault:{available:false,reason:'SOURCE_DEFAULTS_UNAVAILABLE',message:'来源确认：当前资源未绑定此会话'}}
const options={fields:{},presets:[],catalogRevision:'own-catalog'}
const unresolved=(path,session)=>requests.filter(r=>!r.done&&r.url.pathname.endsWith(path)&&r.url.searchParams.get('sessionId')===session)
const settle=(path,session,value)=>unresolved(path,session).forEach(r=>r.resolve(value))
const renderDetail=(session,revision=1)=>flushSync(()=>root.render(h(DetailPage,{row,sessionId:session,liveRevision:revision,onBack(){},onChange(){}})))
const renderPanel=session=>flushSync(()=>root.render(h(ScopedPanel,{sessionId:session})))
const queryData=accepted=>({revision:1,rows:[{...row,...(accepted?{config:success.config,sourceDefault:success.sourceDefault}:{})}],adapters:[{id:row.adapterId,name:'Own source'}],catalogs:[],diagnostics:[],facets:{fields:{},turns:[]}})
const button=label=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent===label)
window.runLoadingChecks=async()=>{
 renderDetail('own-a');await wait(()=>unresolved('/configuration','own-a').length)
 check('detail initial pending hides stale row failure',text().includes('加载中')&&!text().includes('旧范围拒绝')&&!text().includes('不可用'))
 settle('/configuration','own-a',success);settle('/options','own-a',options);await tick()
 check('detail pending to success',text().includes('来源默认规则')&&!text().includes('加载中'))
 renderDetail('own-b');await wait(()=>unresolved('/configuration','own-b').length)
 settle('/configuration','own-b',denial);settle('/options','own-b',options);await tick()
 check('settled source denial shows its concrete message',text().includes('当前资源未绑定此会话')&&!text().includes('加载中'))
 renderDetail('own-b',2);await tick();button('重新载入配置').click();await tick()
 check('reload pending hides previous denial',text().includes('加载中')&&!text().includes('当前资源未绑定此会话'))
 const stale=unresolved('/configuration','own-b');renderDetail('own-c');await wait(()=>unresolved('/configuration','own-c').length)
 stale.forEach(r=>r.reject(Error('旧失败不得进入新页面')));settle('/options','own-b',options);await tick()
 check('cancelled detail error cannot enter new scope',text().includes('加载中')&&!text().includes('旧失败'))
 check('old detail transport is aborted',stale.every(r=>r.signal.aborted))
 const late=unresolved('/configuration','own-c');renderDetail('own-d');await wait(()=>unresolved('/configuration','own-d').length)
 settle('/configuration','own-d',success);settle('/options','own-d',options);await tick()
 late.forEach(r=>r.resolve(denial));settle('/options','own-c',options);await tick()
 check('cancelled detail success cannot replace current result',text().includes('来源默认规则')&&!text().includes('当前资源未绑定此会话'))
 renderDetail('own-e');await wait(()=>unresolved('/configuration','own-e').length)
 unresolved('/configuration','own-e').forEach(r=>r.reject(Error('当前读取被拒绝')));settle('/options','own-e',options);await tick()
 check('settled request error ends loading and shows current error',text().includes('当前读取被拒绝')&&!text().includes('加载中'))
 renderPanel('own-p');await wait(()=>unresolved('/query','own-p').length)
 check('panel initial pending',text().includes('加载中')&&!text().includes('不可用'))
 settle('/query','own-p',queryData(false));await tick()
 check('panel settled denial',text().includes('旧范围拒绝'))
 renderPanel('own-q');check('panel scope changes synchronously hide old failure',text().includes('加载中')&&!text().includes('旧范围拒绝'))
 await wait(()=>unresolved('/query','own-q').length);const staleQuery=unresolved('/query','own-q')
 renderPanel('own-r');await wait(()=>unresolved('/query','own-r').length)
 staleQuery.forEach(r=>r.reject(Error('旧查询拒绝')));await tick()
 check('old query error cannot enter new scope',text().includes('加载中')&&!text().includes('旧查询拒绝'))
 settle('/query','own-r',queryData(true));await tick()
 check('new panel scope settles successfully',text().includes('来源默认规则'))
 button('重新读取管理配置').click();await wait(()=>requests.some(r=>!r.done&&r.url.pathname.endsWith('/reload')))
 requests.filter(r=>!r.done&&r.url.pathname.endsWith('/reload')).forEach(r=>r.resolve({revision:2,unchanged:false}));await tick()
 check('new configuration generation shows pending',text().includes('加载中')&&!text().includes('旧范围拒绝'))
 const oldGeneration=unresolved('/query','own-r')
 button('重新读取管理配置').click();await wait(()=>requests.some(r=>!r.done&&r.url.pathname.endsWith('/reload')))
 requests.filter(r=>!r.done&&r.url.pathname.endsWith('/reload')).forEach(r=>r.resolve({revision:3,unchanged:false}));await tick()
 oldGeneration.forEach(r=>r.reject(Error('旧代次拒绝')));await tick()
 check('same-scope old generation error cannot enter new generation',text().includes('加载中')&&!text().includes('旧代次拒绝'))
 check('same-scope old generation request is aborted',oldGeneration.every(r=>r.signal.aborted))
 settle('/query','own-r',queryData(true));await tick()
 check('configuration generation settles successfully',text().includes('来源默认规则'))
 renderPanel('cold-loading');await wait(()=>unresolved('/query','cold-loading').length)
 check('cold session read remains loading before it settles',text().includes('会话资源加载中')&&!text().includes('unavailable')&&!document.querySelector('[role="alert"]'))
 settle('/query','cold-loading',queryData(true));await tick()
 check('cold read settles into resources',text().includes('来源默认规则')&&!text().includes('加载中'))
 renderPanel('reader-starting');await wait(()=>unresolved('/query','reader-starting').length)
 unresolved('/query','reader-starting').forEach(r=>r.reject(Object.assign(Error('reader not ready'),{code:'SESSION_READER_NOT_READY'})));await tick()
 check('reader initialization is a loading state rather than unavailable',text().includes('正在初始化')&&!text().includes('来源读取失败')&&!document.querySelector('[role="alert"]'))
 renderPanel('missing-session');await wait(()=>unresolved('/query','missing-session').length)
 unresolved('/query','missing-session').forEach(r=>r.reject(Object.assign(Error('Session does not exist'),{code:'SESSION_NOT_FOUND'})));await tick()
 check('confirmed missing session ends loading',text().includes('会话不存在')&&!text().includes('加载中')&&!!document.querySelector('[role="alert"]'))
 renderPanel('failed-read');await wait(()=>unresolved('/query','failed-read').length)
 unresolved('/query','failed-read').forEach(r=>r.reject(Object.assign(Error('corrupt session file'),{code:'SESSION_READ_FAILED'})));await tick()
 check('failed session read remains a distinct failure',text().includes('来源读取失败')&&text().includes('corrupt session file')&&!text().includes('正在初始化'))
 flushSync(()=>root.unmount())
 return checks
}
